name: SecondXight Analytica,Inc.
summary: SecondXight Analytica, Inc., established in Tokyo, Japan, in 2016, provides analytics consulting and AI solutions built on machine learning and deep learning. Its advisory services help clients build tailor-made models for analyzing data and machine learning. AI products include R2Engine, an AI execution platform, SkyFox, an automated model generation service, and SkyFoxHR, an AI analysis tool for application forms.
